lines.text: Enemies of Judah and Benjamin asked to help build, but Zerubbabel refused, since Cyrus had commanded them.
The people of the land tried to frighten Judah and hired counselors against them until Nebuchadnezzar's reign.
The letter warned the king that if rebuilt, rebellious Jerusalem would leave him no dominion west of the Euphrates.
Artaxerxes replied to the associates living in Damascus, ordering the work stopped, and they forcibly stopped the Jews.
